description: Dry-run a transaction before you send it: eth_call + gas estimate at the latest block. Returns success or the decoded revert reason, the return value (decoded when you give a signature), gas units and the fee in native coin and USD. Send raw data, or signature + args and we encode it. Costs $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

signature.description: Instead of data, e.g. balanceOf(address) returns (uint256)
